Hey <@&1417820113981145228> I’d like to re-propose [eip-8261](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8261) for glamsterdam. I have made a tons of modifications to the original idea, (where gas limit steps would be consensus breaking) and now the EIP is just an informational one.
TLDR: read the default gas limit form config.yaml (new optional array field, kinda like bpo schedule)
